subject: german
title: Sports
meta_desc: KS3 German: sports and physical activities.

walkthroughs.body_html: For ball sports use spielen: 'Ich spiele Fussball' (I play football). 'Ich spiele Tennis'. Spielen = play.
For activities like swimming use gehen: 'Ich gehe schwimmen' (I go swimming). Pattern works for skating, climbing too.
Oft = often. Jeden Tag = every day. 'Ich spiele oft Fussball' = 'I often play football'.
